messages:
sara: Morning — pushing the kernel+quant build to staging now. Quick preflight: anyone see blockers for the 09:00 change window? I'll link smoke run in a sec.

deploybot: Started rollout job rdbw-2026-0223-kernel-quant at 1718501240. Target: staging. Notifying eng-runtime.

ajay: I ran the perf smoke earlier, latencies looked fine on low-token. But left a failing rerank test in model-x. @sara probable cause is int8 path in matmul_v2.

priya: Which shard? I can repro locally if you share the build id.

sara: Build id: kv-quant-2026-1718. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4523. Error is: `dot_prod overflow` on nvmatmul.c: line 208.

camille: that's the same stack we saw last release when driver 510.47 landed. Do we have driver-compat matrix for canary hosts?

mike: Deploybot note: automated compatibility checker passed for 12/15 hosts, failed on us-east-2-gpu3. Fallback policy would pin to previous kernel on that host.

ajay: I'd prefer to hold on global rollout until we patch the int8 kernel. Can we do a regional stagger? 10% traffic canary in west + eu.

deploybot: Rollout configured: regions [west, eu] first, slice=10%. TTL pin if >5% errors for 5m.

sara: ok — schedule change window at 09:00 UTC, but let's run a small manual canary at 08:30. @priya can you run the quick repro on us-east-2-gpu3?

priya: On it. Running `./repro.sh kv-quant-2026-1718 --host us-east-2-gpu3`. Will paste results.

priya: repro result: reproduces the dot_prod overflow in int8 path. Attached snippet: ```Traceback: nvmatmul.c:208: dot_prod overflow, scale=0.0001```

camille: Given that, I'd recommend we proceed with regional canary and enable CPU fallback for affected shard in case error rate spikes.

mike: How about rollback criteria: >3% token error rate or OOMs >1 per host in 10m?

ajay: make it stricter — >1% token errors for 10m OR any crashloop.

sara: agreed. Also add a pin TTL of 2h so we don't auto-unpin overnight.

deploybot: Note added: rollback_criteria=['1% token_error_10m','crashloop_any'], pin_ttl=7200s

sara: Who's writing release notes blurb? Need to call out matmul int8 fix pending and staged rollout.

camille: I can draft. Draft: `Kernel update: improved matmul performance and int8 support. Known issue: dot_product overflow on some driver versions; staging-only canary until patch`

ajay: add mitigation: `enabled CPU-fallback in affected hosts and regional rollback triggers`

sara: ok I'll post that in release-notes channel and in the changelog PR. After manual canary at 08:30 if green -> proceed to 09:00 window.

priya: manual canary done: 08:32 — cpu-fallback prevented crash, perf delta -3% tail. No token errors in 30min smoke.

deploybot: Canary slice completed for west and eu, 10% -> metrics stable, no rollback triggered.

mike: schedule for global ramp at 09:00 with 20m staging soak, ops oncall @elena watching thermal + mem.

elena: oncall here. I'll watch nvlink errors and mem usage. Ping me if token errors >0.5%.

sara: thanks team. I'll update the rollout doc and ping legal for release note QA.

ajay: small note — make sure to tag the driver-compat matrix entry so engineering docs reflect the required driver min version.

sara: done. closing thread and will post final status after 09:30.
